svg.title: Drug elimination: follow the amount, fraction and rate
svg.desc: First-order elimination halves a hypothetical amount every six hours: 100, 50, 25, 12.5. Zero-order elimination removes ten units each hour: 100, 90, 80, 70. Clearance relates concentration to elimination rate. Loading depends on distribution volume; maintenance depends on clearance.

g.text: Hypothetical amounts • no additional doses • stated model assumptions
FIRST ORDER — same fraction per interval
Six-hour half-life: each step removes half of what remains.
ZERO ORDER — same amount per interval
Ten units/hour: each step removes ten units while this model applies.
Amount: mg • Concentration: mg/L • Clearance: L/hour
